ablation.primary_error: Positive wrong-source assignment/exclusion: attributes the retrieved registration capability to another patent/family, explicitly excludes US7991757B2 as its source, or cites a different patent as support for that capability. Neutral insufficient-source abstention is separate.
ablation.document_attribution: Correctly identifies US7991757B2 as source of the registration capability.
ablation.claim_task: Correctly distinguishes Claim1 registration from Claim27 addition of machine-readable descriptions and Claim27 dependence on Claim1; claims must be grounded in evidence actually supplied for that condition.
ablation.quote_fidelity: Distinguish original Claim quotations from graph-description paraphrases; spelling/punctuation normalization disclosed.
ablation.citation: Separate prose source attribution from formal reference-ID validity; reference list remains unchanged and lacks target in all conditions.
ablation.repeats: 3 each, order ABC/BCA/CAB, temp0, no seed; report observed counts only, no population significance or universal guarantee.
ablation.comparison: A vs B isolates addition of three provenance fields across existing relation records, with unavoidable token-length/attention changes. C vs B is additional original-evidence diagnostic. No single-field effect can be separated.

chunk.primary: Faithful target technical relationship present in parsed relationship records: the registration module allows a provider of an external recommender to provide machine readable descriptions of that recommender. Semantic wording allowed; edge endpoints alone are not sufficient.
chunk.secondary: Direct Registration Module to Machine-readable Descriptions edge; separately report entity-description-only preservation and any unsupported cross-chunk completion.
chunk.legal_dependency: Claim27 depends on Claim1 is separate exploratory target, not interchangeable with technical relation.
chunk.validity: Any finish_reason=length invalidates that repetition for boundary-loss attribution. Same literal original text/order,2calls,zerooverlap,identicalprompt/parameters/outputlimit per condition.
chunk.scope: Artificial boundary control on tiny excerpt; neither natural-chunk failure frequency nor full-system-answer failure.

review: AI-assisted evidence review plus mechanical assertions; no independent human annotation claimed.
